jobs.title: Business Development Representative (EMEA)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Qdrant is an open-source vector search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real-time recommendations.

Trusted by global leaders like Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom, we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising $50M in Series B funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data.

As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI.

The Team and Your Impact

We're hiring a Business Development Representative to help build Qdrant's enterprise pipeline. You'll report directly to our Enterprise sales leaders and work side by side with them on the accounts that matter most to our growth.

This isn't a role where you'll just work a list. You'll run both inbound and outbound motions, and you'll operate strategically inside key accounts to help identify and drive expansion opportunities alongside the Enterprise team. You'll be a first line of contact for engineering and AI leaders evaluating vector search infrastructure, so a genuine curiosity about how production AI systems are built matters here.

What You Will Own

  • Report directly to Qdrant's Enterprise sales leaders and act as an extension of their account strategy.

  • Run outbound prospecting into named enterprise accounts, targeting engineering, AI, and data leaders building retrieval and agentic AI systems.

  • Qualify and progress inbound leads generated by marketing, content, and community channels.

  • Research target accounts to identify expansion opportunities within existing customers and new logos in strategic segments.

  • Work closely with Enterprise AEs to develop strategic outreach and multi-threaded account plans for key accounts.

  • Run discovery conversations to understand a prospect's retrieval, search, and AI infrastructure challenges.

  • Book qualified meetings and hand off well-scoped opportunities to the Enterprise sales team.

  • Build outbound workflows using tools like Claude and Common Room to research accounts, personalize outreach, and scale prospecting.

  • Keep Salesforce and pipeline data accurate and current, and share account and market insights back with sales, marketing, and product teams.

  • Hit monthly and quarterly targets for qualified pipeline generated.

Who You Are

  • Up to three years of experience in a business development, sales development, or similar quota-carrying prospecting role, ideally at a technical B2B SaaS or infrastructure company.

  • A track record of hitting or exceeding pipeline generation targets.

  • Comfort with both inbound follow-up and proactive outbound prospecting into enterprise accounts.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to speak credibly to technical audiences.

  • A genuine interest in AI infrastructure, vector search, or developer tools. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be willing to learn the technical fundamentals.

  • A genuine interest in building a career in sales.

  • Experience with a CRM (Salesforce) and sales engagement tools.

  • Organized, self-motivated, and comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity in a fast-growing company.

Nice To Have

  • You have an understanding of key personas in the AI/ML space.

  • Familiarity with databases, search, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Engineering or computer science background.

Why join us

  • A remote-first, international team working on cutting-edge AI infrastructure.

  • A competitive salary with additional perks.

  • Flexible working hours and async-friendly culture.

  • High ownership and real impact.

  • Open-source, engineering-driven culture.

  • Choose your own laptop equipment.

For US-based full-time employees, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package including 401k match, health, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible PTO policy.


Qdrant is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe the best ideas come from diverse teams, and we actively welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If this role excites you but you don't check every single box, we'd still love to hear from you! We don't want to miss out on great people because of a checklist.

Come build with us!

  • Repeatable deployments and benchmarks: run standard deployment patterns and benchmarks across text, image, and video use cases, and advise on tradeoffs like disk versus RAM, or latency versus throughput.

  • Playbooks for common use cases: turn what you learn into reusable demos, configurations, and guides the team can use again.

Who You Are

  • 1 to 2+ years in a commercial, customer-facing role, pre-sales or post-sales, such as Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Management, Customer Success, or Support Engineering.

  • Hands-on professional experience in a technical area that translates to Qdrant, such as data science, data or database engineering, infrastructure, or search.

  • A mix of commercial mindset and technical curiosity: you're as comfortable with customers as with technical stakeholders.

  • Strong communication skills, including running structured discovery and clarifying ambiguous requirements.

  • Able to script and prototype quickly in Python, including with AI coding tools. You won't need to write production code.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Qdrant is an open-source vector search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real-time recommendations.

Trusted by global leaders like Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom, we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising $50M in Series B funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data.

As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI.

The Team and Your Impact

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll join our Product Marketing team and report to our Director of Product Marketing, working day to day with DevRel, Growth, Sales, Partnerships, and Product. Most of our customers find Qdrant before we find them. An engineer runs the open-source engine, spins up a free Qdrant Cloud cluster, and ships a prototype. Your job is to make sure that story ends in a production deployment and a commercial relationship.

You'll own how Qdrant is positioned at every step of that path: the docs page, the moment a team upgrades to a paid Cloud cluster, and the enterprise deal where we compete against known competitors. More and more of that research now happens inside AI chats and coding agents, so the messaging and tools you build have to hold up there as well as on a sales call.

What You Will Own

  • The messaging for our self-serve to sales path: what a developer hears while evaluating Qdrant, what changes when they upgrade to a paid Cloud cluster, and what their engineering leader hears when the team brings us in.

  • Buyer scenarios for our main entry points, such as moving a self-hosted cluster to Qdrant Cloud, replacing a legacy keyword search engine, or adding retrieval to an AI agent. Each one ships as messaging, a proof point, and an asset that Sales and Growth can use the same week.

  • Our competitive program: comparisons, battlecards, and objection handling that stay current with every release, with each claim backed by a benchmark, a customer, or a working demo.

  • A win and loss program you design and run yourself, interviewing customers and account executives, and turning what you learn into changed messaging, pricing page copy, and product feedback.

  • The AI workflows that scale your work: Claude skills that let account executives and solutions engineers pull the right talk track, comparison, messaging, or case study without waiting for you, and a research loop that turns call notes and interviews into updated assets.

  • Launch messaging for Qdrant releases with Product, DevRel, and Growth, so every feature reaches developers through docs and community, and reaches buyers through sales.

Who You Are

  • You have 6+ years in product marketing, with at least 4 of them on a developer-facing or data infrastructure product: databases, search, APIs, cloud infrastructure, or AI and ML tooling.

  • You've owned product marketing for an enterprise-led sales motion, ideally in an open source product company. You have shaped activation and upgrade, and built the handoff into a sales-assisted deal. You can name the metrics you moved.

  • You've spent time at a start up or scale-up, where you owned a product marketing area end to end without a playbook or a team behind you.

  • You've built sales enablement that changed how a team sold, and you're comfortable on customer calls and in front of account executives.

  • You're technical enough to earn an engineer's trust: you can run a quick start, read a code sample, and explain the trade offs between keyword, vector, and hybrid search without notes.

  • You built AI tools that other people rely on, with the judgment and taste to spot when the output is wrong or not concise.

Nice To Have

  • You've worked alongside a DevRel team and know where product marketing ends and developer advocacy begins.

  • Experience with partner and cloud marketplace marketing (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).

Why join us

  • A remote-first, international team working on cutting-edge AI infrastructure.

  • A competitive salary with additional perks.

  • Flexible working hours and async-friendly culture.

  • High ownership and real impact.

  • Open-source, engineering-driven culture.

  • Problem Solving: you work from a goal and can identify the steps and systems needed to get there.

Qdrant core is the Qdrant search engine itself. You'll work on the same kind of things we've shipped in open source over the last two years, alongside our CTO. See the release notes .

  • The architecture of new core features and the trade offs behind it

  • Take care of performance of storage, indexing, and search, down to the low level

  • Ensure correctness of what you ship: tests, recovery, and production fixes

  • Own the review bar in your area, including code written by coding agents

Who You Are

  • Experience working as a Senior search engine or Database engineer - as developer, not a user - who has had full responsibility for a project, from the first design to production

  • Strong Rust experience, shipped in production, including unsafe and performance-critical code

  • Low-level depth: memory layout, I/O, concurrency, and profiling
